questions.prompt: What happened when Spark sneezed beside the Crystal Stream?
choices: The fish turned purple, and the water sang in a different key.
The stream froze, and the fish fell asleep.
The pebbles flew up, and the water disappeared.
questions.answer: The fish turned purple, and the water sang in a different key.
questions.evidenceText: Every fish in the stream turned purple. The water sang in a different key.

questions.prompt: Why is Spark's cold a big problem?
choices: His magic changes things whenever he sneezes.
His cold makes everyone else lose their voice.
His magic vanishes whenever he rests in bed.
questions.answer: His magic changes things whenever he sneezes.
questions.rationale: Spark's breakfast sneeze turns porridge into a bird, and his meadow sneeze changes every flower's colour; because different sneezes cause different magical changes, his cold is a big problem whenever he sneezes.
questions.evidenceText: He sneezed at breakfast. The porridge turned into a bird. The bird flew out of the window. Spark stared at his empty bowl.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: But Spark's magic crackled around him all the time. A cold, for Spark, was a very big problem.
He sneezed in the Whispering Meadow. Every flower changed colour at the same moment. The meadow turned entirely blue.

questions.prompt: What did Wren's cold remedy accomplish?
choices: Spark's cold was gone, and the flowers and fish returned to normal.
Spark's cold stayed, and the flowers and fish changed forever.
Spark controlled every sneeze, and nothing else returned to normal.
questions.answer: Spark's cold was gone, and the flowers and fish returned to normal.
questions.rationale: Wren finds a cold remedy, and then Spark's cold is gone while the flowers and fish return to normal; this shows the remedy cured the cold and reversed those earlier changes.
questions.evidenceText: The remedy worked. Spark's cold was gone. The flowers slowly turned back to their usual colours. The fish returned to normal.

supportingEvidence.evidenceText: Wren found a cold remedy in her spell book. She read it very, very carefully.
